svg.title: Hold the per-layer variance factor at one
svg.desc: A stack of twenty layer bars beside three signal-width ribbons: a Gaussian initialisation flaring outward to a standard deviation of 3.1e6 and then NaN, Xavier on ReLU tapering to a hairline at 1.2e-3 by layer twenty with the arithmetic 0.707 to the twentieth equals one over 1024 left visible, and He initialisation holding constant width at 0.87, with layer-one gradient norms of 4.7e-6 against 1.9e-2 and four small inset loss-curve shapes.
svg.text: Hold the per-layer variance factor at one
and the four curves you will see
...and which one is yours? -> the playbook
